data.long_meaning: Derived from Old Irish 'Fionnghalach', meaning 'fair-stranger'. This name was traditionally given to a traveler or stranger who was welcomed into a community due to his fair appearance or good qualities. The name Findley carries the meaning “Fair one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Findley usually hope their child will grow to embody fair one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: פינדלי
in_hebrew.meaning: פינדלי משמעותו מורכב מ-פין ו-לי שפירושם פני אלוהים או אלוהים עלי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פינדלי הוא שם נוצרי שמורכב משני חלקים: פין ו-לי. פין שפירושו פני אלוהים או אלוהים, ו-לי שפירושו שייך לאלוהים או עלי. לכן, פינדלי יכול להתפרש כ-פני אלוהים עלי או אלוהים שייך לי. השם פינדלי משמש בשם נוצרי ויש לו משמעות עמוקה בהקשר הדתי.

in_greek.name: Φίντλεϋ
in_greek.meaning: Φίντλεϋ σημαίνει το πρόσωπο του Θεού ή ο Θεός είναι μαζί μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Φίντλεϋ είναι χριστιανικό και προέρχεται από δύο λέξεις: Φιν και Λει. Το Φιν σημαίνει πρόσωπο του Θεού ή Θεός, ενώ το Λει σημαίνει ανήκει στον Θεό ή πάνω στον Θεό. Επομένως, το Φίντλεϋ μπορεί να ερμηνευτεί ως το πρόσωπο του Θεού μαζί μου ή ο Θεός είναι μαζί μου. Το όνομα αυτό έχει βαθιά σημασία στο χριστιανικό πλαίσιο.

in_latin.name: Findley
in_latin.meaning: Findley means face of God or God is with me
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Findley is of Christian origin, derived from two elements: Fin and Ley. Fin signifies face of God or God, while Ley means belonging to God or upon God. Thus, Findley can be interpreted as face of God with me or God is with me. This name holds profound significance within the Christian tradition.

in_english.name: Findley

in_english.long_meaning: The name Findley is of Scottish origin, derived from the Gaelic name Fionnlagh, which means fair-haired warrior or white warrior. In Christian context, it is often associated with the meaning 'face of God' or 'God is with me', reflecting a deep spiritual connection. Historically, the name Findley has been used in various cultures, symbolizing strength, divine presence, and purity. Today, it remains a popular choice for parents seeking a name that embodies both heritage and faith.

This name would have held great cultural significance during the time when travelers and wanderers were an integral part of Irish society. It reflects the hospitality and welcoming nature of Irish communities towards strangers, and the importance they placed on treating all people with kindness and generosity, regardless of their background.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Findley" also carries deep spiritual significance, as it highlights the importance of openness and acceptance towards others. Additionally, the name "Findley" can be seen as a symbol of the Christian belief in welcoming strangers and offering them a place in the community. This can be reflected in the commandment to "love your neighbor as yourself" (Mark 12:31), and the biblical stories of hospitality, such as that of Abraham and the three visitors (Genesis 18:1-8).
